snippet.title: Horn & Dice - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Horn & Dice is a dicebuilder that turns luck based dice rolling into a roguelike by layering skill based depth into it. Forge a unique dice build, combat against creatures from Slavic myth, discover artifacts and potions and solve the mystery of the Horn.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4971770/Horn__Dice/
